notes: Fixed: the game crashed when you went back to the menu (or opened Controls) while holding a gun.
Every mod item is in the creative inventory now: guns and ammo in Combat, the Flashlight and its battery in Tools, the pills in Brewing - and all of them in Search.
Typing a command shows suggestions like in newer versions: start with / and a list appears - Tab or a click fills it in, the arrow keys pick, Escape hides it. Works on servers too.
Guns: spent cases fly out when you fire, the sights stay steady while you aim and shoot, and you can see other players' muzzle flash.
